_comment: Synthetic Shopify Admin API responses for GET /orders.json?name=<n>&status=any. Pin one onto 'Look up order (Shopify)' to test without a store. Every email uses the reserved .test domain.

1001._case: shipped, with tracking. Matches only when the email is sam.sample@example.test

1003._case: partly shipped, no tracking URL on the fulfilment

_unauthorised._case: what Shopify returns with a bad token. Must route to a person, not to 'order not found'
_unauthorised.errors: [API] Invalid API key or access token (unrecognized login or wrong password)
